بِهِ مَاسِحٌ He (a camel) has a fretting of the edge of the callosity upon his breast, produced by his elbow, without making it bleed: if he make it bleed, you say بِهِ حَازٌّ: (S, L:) and he has a chafing of his arm-pit produced by his elbow, but not violent, by reason of the disease called ضَاغِط. (L.) ―
-b2- See مَسِيحٌ. ―
-b3- مَاسِحٌ and ↓ مَسِيحٌ A great slayer; one who slays much, or many. (Az, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
